messages:
alex (pm): Heads-up — inbound from a mid-market customer asking for a small bundle: Terraform module for provisioning Dedicated seats, a Python SDK convenience wrapper for streaming, SCIM SSO connector, and a marketplace listing. They say timeline is ~quarterly procurement. Can we triage?

maria (solutions): Thx. Quick clarifying Qs from pre-sale call: they need SCIM to sync groups -> role mapping, and terraform to automate capacity reservations. Also want example app using streaming + reconnect logic.

tyler (sales): priority = medium but revenue motion likely upsell to Dedicated. customer name redacted for now. They asked for estimated ship time to include in the proposal.

alex (pm): I think we should treat as one intake but split into 3 deliverables: 1) terraform module + docs 2) SCIM connector + SSO mapping docs 3) python SDK example + marketplace packaging. Propose tagging as "integration-requests" + "marketplace" and P2 backlog. Thoughts?

jess (eng): Technical constraints: terraform module mostly wraps existing infra APIs; low dev time. SCIM connector needs auth support (OIDC + SCIM). SDK streaming wrapper needs reconnect + token refresh patterns; can reuse code from internal demo. Estimated rough effort: terraform 3-5d, SCIM 10-14d incl tests, SDK + example 5-7d.

nina (support): We should capture the acceptance criteria from support side: scim user provisioning + deprovisioning tested, audit logs available, example terraform shows plan/apply against dedicated sandbox.

alex (pm): OK. Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- Terraform module: one HCL module, examples for dedicated and hosted, README, 2 integration tests that run against staging infra.
- SCIM connector: support user create/update/deprovision, group sync mapping to roles, end-to-end test with sample IdP, documented RBAC considerations.
- Python SDK: high-level streaming helper with auto-reconnect and token refresh example, small sample app in repo, README + pip packaging instructions.

maria (solutions): Add launch criteria: security review completed for SCIM, QA smoke pass on staging, a customer-facing quickstart doc for each deliverable. Also request a one-hour enablement session for the customer.

jess (eng): For rollout plan: start with terraform + sdk sample (low risk), then SCIM connector. Parallelize docs while eng implements. Need infra env for integration tests — can we get a "customer-sand" org? @intake-bot can you create a tracking ticket in GH and link to a staging org?

intake-bot: Created GH issue #4521: "connector: customer request - terraform/python/scim + marketplace". Assigned to alex (pm). Staging org request ticket #987 opened.

alex (pm): Thanks bot. Action items:
- alex: consolidate GH issue with acceptance criteria and add labels [integration-requests, marketplace, p2] (ETA EOD)
- jess: spike SCIM auth options and post short notes (ETA 2d)
- maria: draft quickstart snippets for terraform + python (ETA 3d)
- tyler: share redacted customer procurement timeline and point of contact (ETA EOD)
- nina: define test cases for support (ETA 3d)

maria (solutions): Also recommend adding a "cost-profile" note for Dedicated (expected throughput / monthly cost) so sales can scope budget.

tyler (sales): will add.

alex (pm): Decision: tag as described and queue in next intake grooming. If no objections by EOD I’ll move to triage column and set milestone for next sprint planning window.

jess (eng): No objections. Slight ask: if timeline compresses, we might drop marketplace listing from initial delivery and follow up — call that phased delivery.

alex (pm): noted — phased delivery ok. Marketplace listing becomes follow-up unless sales needs it included.

maria (solutions): One more thing — include example config for role mapping in docs. Quick snippet for clarity:

```json
{
  "scim_mapping": {
    "groups": {
      "engineering": "engineer",
      "ops": "sre"
    }
  }
}
```

nina (support): +1 on mapping example. Also track GDPR data flow note for SCIM.

alex (pm): Perfect. I’ll update GH issue and label now. Thanks team — I’ll ping when grooming slot is booked. :white_check_mark:

tyler (sales): thanks all, will loop in customer once we have a tentative ship date. :thumbsup:
